senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Nahăwand, a Median town south of Ecbatana (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 377, a. Sm. Dict. Geogr. II, 495ᵃ s. v. Orontes).
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 72a:6">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite> ‘the cities of Maday’ (<cite ref="II Kings 18:12">II Kings XVIII, 12</cite>) <he>זו נ׳ וחברותיה וכ׳</he> that means N. and her neighbors; … the forts of the Moschi &c.; <cite ref="Yevamot 17a">Yeb. 17ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="N00630"><he>ניהר</he></cite> (corr. acc.). Kidd. l. c. <he>חלזון ניהוונד</he>, v. <cite ref="H00991"><he>חָלְוַון</he></cite> (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 372, sq.).—[Our art. <cite ref="M00687"><he>מוֹשְׁכִּי</he></cite> needs correction; <cite ref="M00687"><he>כרך מ׳</he></cite> must be sought in Media.]
